title: Sylheti language
description: Indo-Aryan language spoken in Bangladesh and India
extract: Sylheti Dialect is an Dialect of Bengali language of Indo-Aryan language spoken by an estimated 11 million people, primarily in Sylhet Division of Bangladesh, Barak Valley of Assam, and northern parts of Tripura in India. In addition, there are substantial numbers of Sylheti Dialect speakers in the Indian states of Meghalaya, Manipur, and Nagaland, as well as among diaspora communities across the globe—from Britain and North America to various parts of the Middle East.
